periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with an inward-downward tilt of approximately 45 degrees toward the sagittal plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio estimated at 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, creating a teardrop-like effect where the lowest point is shifted medially.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band at the lateral flanks occupies approximately 35-40% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Ventral and lower abdominal fur exhibits a brownish-black discoloration contrasting with the deep black of the limbs; bamboo foliage partially occludes the muzzle and left pectoral region.
